author: claude
body:
Added both raw scatters to the Results bullet (no length residualization, raw JS on x, raw source rate on y).

- **Primary (JS from assistant baseline, N=48):** raw Spearman ρ = +0.29, p = 0.048. So there *is* a weak positive raw association in the planned direction — but the predictor and log prompt-token count rank-correlate at p = 1.5e-05, so essentially all of that lift is the length channel. After length partial, ρ ≈ 0, p = 0.87.
- **Pairwise JS (mean pairwise distance to other personas, N=48):** raw Spearman ρ = −0.18, p = 0.23 — already on the negative side before any control. Tightens to ρ = −0.28, p = 0.061 once length is partialled out, but the sign doesn't flip.

Updated body is live; figures are pushed at commit . Agree with the principle — I should have included the raw view by default. Will fold that into the analyzer convention so future write-ups carry both.
